doc.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s an excellent coda to our session here. Well this has just been a joy for me, thank you for the joy in the morning as you said, and the afternoon and evening.
Yeah. And I wish you continued success, and thank you for the good shuffles.
You’re welcome. Thank you for the good questions.
And I hope the tour goes well, and “Healing Time” as well.
Oh I appreciate that. Thank you.
I’ll sign us off and we’ll say our good-byes. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
